package duel

import "core:math"
import r "godot:replay"
import p "godot:replay/play"
import h "godot:replay/history"
import net "godot:replay/net"
import lb "godot:replay/lobby"

CONTENT :: u64(0x52515549434b4432)
SEATS :: 4
HZ :: u32(60)
RUN_SPEED :: f32(2.2)
DASH_SPEED :: f32(7)
DASH_CD :: u16(45)
DASH_LEN :: u16(8)
FIRE_CD :: u16(18)
LOB_CD :: u16(48)
LOB_LIFE :: u16(70)
BODY_RADIUS :: f32(9)
FIRE :: u8(1)
DASH :: u8(2)
LOB :: u8(4)
CRATES :: [2]p.Aabb2{{{180, 70}, {230, 150}}, {{410, 70}, {460, 150}}}
SPAWNS :: [4][2]f32{{60, 60}, {580, 60}, {60, 300}, {580, 300}}

Player :: struct {
    initialized, connected:        bool,
    position, velocity, drone:     [2]f32,
    aim, dash_cd, fire_cd, lob_cd: u16,
    hp:                            i32,
    gold:                          u8,
    boots:                         bool,
    respawn_at:                    u64,
    kills, deaths, life:           u32,
}

Bullet :: struct {
    key:                u64,
    position, velocity: [2]f32,
    life:               u16,
    owner:              u8,
}

World :: struct {
    names:                                           [SEATS]lb.Name,
    started, manual_start:                           bool,
    players:                                         [SEATS]Player,
    bullets:                                         r.Pool(Bullet, 64),
    history:                                         h.History([SEATS]p.Hurtbox2, 32),
    clock:                                           u64,
    shots, hits, lobs, lands, buys, expired_queries: u32,
    rewind:                                          bool,
    spawn_offset:                                    u8,
    starting_gold:                                   u8,
}

Controls :: struct {
    move, drone: [2]i8,
    aim:         u16,
    buttons:     u8,
}

Action :: struct {
    item:  u8,
    name:  lb.Name,
    start: bool,
}

Event_Kind :: enum u8 {
    Shot,
    Hit,
    Killed,
    Respawned,
    Lobbed,
    Landed,
    Bought,
}

Event :: struct {
    kind:             Event_Kind,
    seat, target:     u8,
    position:         [2]f32,
    aim:              u16,
    key, judged_tick: u64,
    query:            net.View_Status,
}

initial :: proc(rewind: bool = true, dedicated: bool = false, gold: u8 = 0, manual_start: bool = false) -> World {
    return {
        rewind = rewind,
        spawn_offset = dedicated ? 1 : 0,
        starting_gold = gold,
        started = !manual_start,
        manual_start = manual_start,
    }
}

spawn :: proc(w: ^World, seat: u16) -> [2]f32 {
    spots := SPAWNS
    return spots[(int(seat) + int(w.spawn_offset)) % len(spots)]
}

angle :: proc(value: u16) -> f32 {
    return f32(value) * (2 * math.PI / 65536)
}

aim :: proc(value: f32) -> u16 {
    turn := value / (2 * math.PI)
    turn -= math.floor(turn)
    return u16(turn * 65536)
}

direction :: proc(value: u16) -> [2]f32 {
    a := angle(value)
    return {math.cos(a), math.sin(a)}
}

normalize :: proc(v: [2]f32) -> [2]f32 {
    length := math.sqrt(v[0] * v[0] + v[1] * v[1])
    return length <= 0.00001 ? [2]f32{} : v / length
}

model :: proc() -> net.Model(World, Controls, Action, Event, SEATS) {
    return {
        step_view = step,
        action = buy,
        reset_player = reset_player,
        control_valid = control_valid,
        action_valid = action_valid,
        state_valid = state_valid,
        hold = proc(c: Controls) -> Controls {
            return c
        },
        event_owner = proc(e: Event) -> u16 {
            return u16(e.kind == .Hit || e.kind == .Killed ? e.target : e.seat)
        },
    }
}

control_valid :: proc(c: Controls) -> bool {
    return(
        c.move[0] >= -1 &&
        c.move[0] <= 1 &&
        c.move[1] >= -1 &&
        c.move[1] <= 1 &&
        c.drone[0] >= -1 &&
        c.drone[0] <= 1 &&
        c.drone[1] >= -1 &&
        c.drone[1] <= 1 &&
        c.buttons & ~u8(7) == 0 \
    )
}

state_valid :: proc(w: World) -> bool {
    if w.spawn_offset > 1 || (!w.manual_start && !w.started) {
        return false
    }

    for name in w.names {
        if !lb.name_valid(name) {
            return false
        }
    }

    for player in w.players {
        if player.hp < 0 ||
           player.hp > 3 ||
           (player.initialized && player.life == 0) ||
           player.dash_cd > DASH_CD ||
           player.fire_cd > FIRE_CD ||
           player.lob_cd > LOB_CD {
            return false
        }
    }

    count := u32(0)

    for bullet, i in w.bullets.values {
        if w.bullets.alive[i] {
            count += 1

            if bullet.key == 0 ||
               bullet.owner < 1 ||
               bullet.owner > SEATS ||
               bullet.life == 0 ||
               bullet.life > LOB_LIFE ||
               w.bullets.generations[i] == 0 {
                return false
            }
        }
    }

    return count == w.bullets.count
}

leader :: proc(w: ^World) -> u16 {
    for player, i in w.players {
        if player.connected {
            return u16(i + 1)
        }
    }

    return 0
}

action_valid :: proc(a: Action) -> bool {
    if !lb.name_valid(a.name) || a.item > 1 {
        return false
    }

    return int(a.item == 1) + int(a.name.length > 0) + int(a.start) == 1
}
